product.title: Cabo San Lucas Glass Bottom Kayak Tour and Snorkel at Two Bays

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this outing pairs a glass-bottom kayak with snorkel time at Santa María Bay and Chileno Bay. Hotel pickup arrives by air-conditioned van, then a bilingual guide issues life jackets, snorkel gear, and a wetsuit when needed. The kayak crossing between the two bays is the published movement rather than a motorboat hop, so the day stays on the reefs and rock formations of the corridor. Dry bags are listed for phones and wallets. The format suits visitors who want a guided paddle-and-swim without renting kayaks independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on Santa María Bay and Chileno Bay that shape this two-bay outing rather than a Land's End yacht add-on.

highlights: Visit some of Cabo’s most spectacular snorkeling spots on this affordable excursion
